messages:
sam: quick idea: replace reserve+prefill+commit with one LeaseBridge(prefix,intent) to shrink race windows and simplify metrics.

maria: what does the return look like?

sam: short: status in {HELD,TAKEOVER,FALLBACK}, optional token, grace_seconds, allowed_ops, pinned?, reason_hint.

aj: how avoid stale reads on TAKEOVER?

sam: TAKEOVER returns min_residency_epoch. Consumer must ackFence(prefix,epoch) before serving reads. Only for TAKEOVER.

leo: renewals? long prefill might need it.

sam: leaseRenew(token) for HELD leases to extend grace. Tokens MACed by node id.

maria: metrics mapping?

sam: emit bridge.request/granted/prefill.start/prefill.end/fallback/renew to map old events.

infra-bot: rollout note: keep old reserve endpoints for 28 days; coordinator behind feature flag.

aj: tests: monotonic transition unit tests, takeover fence integration, chaos kill owner during prefill.

sam: I'll draft RFC+proto EOW and PoC in prefixcache. Thanks.
